careers.title: Software Engineer
careers.description: Design, develop, and maintain software applications and systems. Write code, debug programs, and collaborate with teams to deliver software solutions.
careers.outlook: High demand in BPO, tech startups, and enterprise companies

careers.title: Registered Nurse
careers.description: Provide patient care, administer medications, and assist in medical procedures. Work in hospitals, clinics, and community health settings.
careers.outlook: Consistent demand locally and abroad; NCLEX passers command premium salaries

careers.title: Mechanical Engineer
careers.description: Design, analyze, and manufacture mechanical systems. Work in automotive, manufacturing, energy, and HVAC industries.
careers.outlook: Steady demand in manufacturing, construction, and energy sectors

careers.title: Certified Public Accountant
careers.description: Prepare financial statements, conduct audits, and ensure tax compliance. Work in accounting firms, corporations, and government agencies.
careers.outlook: Essential across all industries; data analytics skills increase competitiveness

careers.title: Elementary School Teacher
careers.description: Teach foundational subjects to young learners. Develop lesson plans, assess student progress, and create engaging learning environments.
careers.outlook: Stable demand; DepEd hiring annually; licensure exam required

careers.title: Graphic Designer
careers.description: Create visual content for brands, media, and digital platforms. Design logos, marketing materials, and user interfaces.
careers.outlook: Strong demand in marketing, advertising, and tech industries

careers.title: Physician / Medical Doctor
careers.description: Diagnose and treat illnesses, injuries, and medical conditions. Specialize in fields like surgery, internal medicine, or pediatrics.
careers.outlook: High demand; long training but high earning potential

careers.title: Civil Engineer
careers.description: Design, construct, and maintain infrastructure projects including buildings, roads, bridges, and water systems.
careers.outlook: Driven by infrastructure projects; licensed practitioners preferred

careers.title: Psychologist
careers.description: Assess and treat mental health conditions, conduct research, and provide counseling services to individuals and groups.
careers.outlook: Growing awareness of mental health; RPsych licensure required for practice

careers.title: Licensed Architect
careers.description: Design buildings and structures, prepare construction documents, and oversee building projects from concept to completion.
careers.outlook: Construction boom drives demand; board exam is a significant hurdle

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.description: Analyze complex data sets to extract insights, build predictive models, and support business decision-making.
careers.outlook: One of the fastest-growing fields; strong demand across industries

careers.title: Human Resources Manager
careers.description: Oversee recruitment, employee relations, training, and organizational development in companies.
careers.outlook: Essential in all organizations; strategic HR roles growing

careers.title: Chef / Culinary Professional
careers.description: Prepare and cook food, create menus, and manage kitchen operations in restaurants, hotels, and catering services.
careers.outlook: Tourism growth drives demand; cruise line opportunities available

careers.title: Medical Technologist
careers.description: Perform laboratory tests on blood, tissue, and body fluids to assist in disease diagnosis and treatment.
careers.outlook: Essential in healthcare; consistent demand in hospitals and labs

careers.title: Entrepreneur / Business Owner
careers.description: Start and manage your own business. Identify opportunities, develop products/services, and build a customer base.
careers.outlook: DOST and DTI support programs available; high risk but high reward

careers.title: Physical Therapist
careers.description: Help patients recover movement and manage pain through exercise, manual therapy, and rehabilitation programs.
careers.outlook: Growing demand; aging population and sports medicine expansion

careers.title: Marketing Manager
careers.description: Develop marketing strategies, manage campaigns, and drive brand growth across digital and traditional channels.
careers.outlook: Digital marketing skills especially valued; constant demand across industries

careers.title: Pharmacist
careers.description: Dispense medications, counsel patients on drug use, and ensure safe medication practices.
careers.outlook: Retail, hospital, and industrial pharmacy roles available

careers.title: Secondary School Teacher
careers.description: Teach specialized subjects to high school students. Develop curriculum, assess learning, and mentor adolescents.
careers.outlook: STEM teachers especially in demand; licensure exam required

careers.title: Tourism / Hospitality Manager
careers.description: Manage hotel operations, travel services, and tourism programs. Ensure quality guest experiences and operational efficiency.
careers.outlook: Tourism recovery driving demand; international cruise opportunities
